text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It's been quite a while since that victory in America.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, picking up the victory commemorative photo
sitting on the desk, the memories of that day
come vividly rushing back――

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Jeez, you're exaggerating!
If you fool around too much, you're gonna hurt yourself!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...You saw that good, right? I'm
the world's strongest—your badass daughter."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"So there's no need to worry.
I'm way stronger than ya think, ya know."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? The old man was watching too...?
I-It's not like I'm happy about it or anything!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—Ah! My bad, another call's coming in!
Talk to you later, Mom.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yoo-hoo, Espo-n! Congrats on the win!
Man, that seriously gave me goosebumps~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
After watching a race like that,
how could you not feel the shivers—they just won't stop, right?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "Hah...! If that's the case, what are you gonna do about it?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course!
It's my turn to dive in now, right?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Look forward to your "souvenir" from Dubai, okay♪

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Haha. Tran's got quite a mouth on her.
Still..."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Aaargh, damn it...!
...My heart is still pounding out of my chest...!
choice_data_list: You proved that you're the strongest, Espoir.
You proved that you're the strongest, Espo.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Hah? Hey, you bastard.
Who the hell do you think you're messing with, huh?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
It's not 'me'!
It's 'us', dammit!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Don't you dare forget all the effort you and I put in together, damn it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'll never forget the joy from that moment.
Not now. Not ever—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you!
Stop daydreaming!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Grinning at that again, huh?
You really, really love that thing...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Man, I get feeling all restless and excited.
...I mean, even I still get floating-on-air moments sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: But—are you really satisfied with that, bastard?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
We can still go further, right?
—The two of us, I mean.
choice_data_list: Yeah. Beyond the pinnacle of the world—!
Yeah. Beyond the top of the world—!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hah! So you do get it after all.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Here, take this. The pages in your old one were completely blackened, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She handed over a brand-new notebook,
likely bought from the school store.
Yet to the two of us, this was—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Look, the first page is blank. What are you gonna write next?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"What kind of dream
are you entrusting to me?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Holding the new "textbook" in hand,
I spoke to Espoir City.
choice_data_list: Let's talk about that on our way to the grounds.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, sure thing.
I'll listen to whatever dream you've got.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Your... "world's strongest Umamusume," that is!
